head: Oboe offers a feed of puzzles instead of endless scrolling
dek: Oboe is an endless feed of interactive games and puzzles, meant to replace mindless scrolling. It was #40 among free Education apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: It came out on 31 October, made by Oboe Labs. It's free.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, free
means: If you want to swap some scrolling time for puzzles, it gives you a feed that works the same way.
todo: Find Oboe in the App Store.
